name: ATMOSPHERE OS — HEADER FIT
changes: Keeps every desktop navigation item on one line after the global search action was added
Expands the header working width while preserving the storefront container rhythm
Uses a compact desktop navigation between 1200–1439 px and the burger menu below 1200 px
Delays the phone shortcut until wide desktop and hides the redundant Instagram header shortcut on compact desktop widths
notes: Search, account and cart remain visible across all supported desktop widths.
Mobile navigation content and behavior are unchanged.
No checkout, Supabase, payment, product or search-index logic changed in this release.
